gyms.title: My gyms
gyms.subtitle: Describe the equipment you train with. The plate calculator, weight steps and exercise suggestions follow your active gym.
gyms.emptyHint: Add one to get plate math and weight steps that match your equipment.

editGym.name: Name

restrictions.subtitle: These won't be suggested in swaps or generated workouts.

plateCalculator.subtitle: Loading {{weight}} {{unit}}
plateCalculator.barOnly: Just the bar — no plates needed.

restTimer.title: Rest timer
restTimer.subtitle: How rests behave between sets.
restTimer.autoStartHint: After you complete a set. Turn off to start rests yourself with the Start rest button.

autonomy.title: When a workout starts
autonomy.subtitle: Decide how much of today's numbers the app chooses.
autonomy.suggestHint: Each exercise starts from how its last session went — more load, more reps, a deload, or a repeat. You'll see why, and can undo it.
